description: Month-by-month history of a single keyword from Google Search Console (clicks, impressions, impression-weighted position) plus the pages ranking for it. Use it to see how a query developed, whether it is seasonal, or which page Google shows for it. Pass the query exactly as Search Console lists it. 16 months for paid domains, 3 months otherwise. Requires the user to have connected Search Console. Responses follow the account language (German by default).

domainId.description: Domain id of one of the user's projects, as returned by list_domains.

months.description: History length in months, defaults to 16 (paid domains only; free gets 3).

query.description: The exact search query, e.g. 'seo tool kostenlos'.

name: keyword_history
title: Keyword history
